newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO SETS J/V WITH EMSLAND-STARKE.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO SETS J/V WITH EMSLAND-STARKE.

text.p: Finnish food, feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy said on Thursday it had sealed a deal with Emsland-Starke GmbH of Germany on a joint venture to market chemicals and starch products.

"Raisio Chemicals ... and Emsland-Starke ... have decided to form a joint venture to sell and market the parent companies' chemicals and starch products to the paper industry in Germany, Austria and the Netherlands," Raisio said in a statement.
"The name of the new enterprise will be Emsland Raisio Chemie GmbH and it will be located in Hamburg," Raisio said, adding that it would begin operations this spring.
The new joint venture will operate as part of Raisio Chemicals' global operations and is expected to have net sales of 60 million German marks in its first 12 months of operations, Raisio said.
Emsland-Starke is the world's second largest potato starch producer with five factories in Germany and annual net sales of more than 400 million German marks, Raisio said.
Its main shareholders are German potato growers and it produces about 400,000 tonnes of starch annually, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
